authority: 최신 USER: fluency/consistency는 2k 시점에만 평가한다. 승인된 first2000 편집 실험의 새/수리 source부터 W20-only 일정을 적용한다. 기존 frozen archive/raw/과거 점수는 보존하며 GH 정책 변경만으로 무관한 job을 취소·재시작하지 않는다.
applies_to: Future authorized ours and baseline editing experiments; setup/stats/P/storage smoke excluded. This task authorizes generation evaluation forwards inside six-baseline reruns, not additional fits or scientific pilots.

audit_results.scope: Random tiny CPU models / implementation diagnosis only; not pretrained/GPU qualification.

reference_assets.reuse: Find an existing verified cache first. If absent, this envelope allows one-time download of these three native CounterFact evaluation assets only; bind URL/size/SHA/schema and ordered case coverage. No model/C0/P downloads, no silent TF-IDF refit/recomputation.
reference_assets.schema: snippets list relation_id/target_id/samples[].text; fixed token->dense-index vocabulary, finite 1D idf length |vocab|. Same saved vocab/idf for all models/methods; no fitting to generated outputs.
reference_assets.tokenizer: Bind NLTK version and exact required punkt/punkt_tab language resources; explicitly prepare missing tokenizer resource once. No silent regex substitution. Use isolated CPU scoring environment if necessary; do not upgrade a scientific runtime.
reference_assets.transfer: SH1 publishes compact manifest/READY and generation source; exact evaluation asset bundle may be pulled once by SH2/SH3/SH4 to ignored namespace with full size/SHA verification, no destructive sync. Models/data/checkpoints/secrets/raw experiment outputs are not part of this bundle.
reference_assets.unavailable: Typed ASSET_NOT_AVAILABLE/coverage reasons, no fabricated scores. Missing snippet for a case is metric unavailability, not zero; report planned and valid counts.

generation.distinction: CAKE score formulas and references retained. Generator repairs and native-EOS stopping are a declared evaluation revision, not upstream byte parity or unchanged published-paper numbers. No continuation-only or max_new_tokens=100 metric is substituted.
generation.prompts: Exactly fixed CounterFact generation_prompts at each request occurrence, all cases interval=1. Not rewrite prompt, paraphrase or model-generated editing contexts. No chat template injection.

sampling.length_unit: unpadded model input tokens + generated tokens

generation.length: Each row independently stops at its total-token limit. Preserve input tokens exactly; no truncation/drop. A prompt already >=100 gets zero continuation and a length-cap reason; it never suppresses shorter rows. Record continuation length/coverage separately.
generation.eos: Stop that row on its model/tokenizer's native EOS IDs, including multi-EOS model configs; pad tokens are not continuation. Record actual binding. This differs from CAKE legacy no-EOS-stop, and profile declares it.
generation.decode: Full prompt+continuation, skip_special_tokens=True, CAKE NFKD and double-newline-to-space normalization. Remove special token IDs via tokenizer, not a GPT2-only string replacement; retain raw token/text locally for reproducibility.
generation.attention: Correct accumulated cache attention mask (cache+query), model-specific causal/position mapping and per-row termination. Padding must not overwrite prompt. Qualified cached/batched route or explicit unpadded per-row full-prefix reference route is allowed; no silent generic fallback.
generation.reference_route: An unpadded single-row full-prefix reference is an allowed safe implementation route. Qualify chosen generator route against its logits/token coordinate reference at unchanged RNG, fixed cases; CPU software checks and B1-integrated actual forward checks only, no extra fit/GPU scientific pilot.

randomness.key: model identity + ordered request occurrence + generation-prompt index
randomness.isolate: Save and finally restore Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/all relevant CUDA RNG states. Generation cannot change subsequent native edit RNG/context/state. Capture W/H/nonselected parameter/observer guard; no persistent hooks/caches after evaluation.

generation.cache: Use one endpoint/case/profile/seed generated observation for both metrics. Reuse already measured overlap and identity-matched W0 scores; no second generation per metric. Cache raw generated text/tokens only locally, no tensors/checkpoints.

fluency.formula: NLTK word-token H2/3 + 2*H3/3, Hn=-sum p_n log2 p_n. Equivalent native weights [2/3,4/3] and mean over n=2,3.
fluency.per_case: Arithmetic mean of entropy across that occurrence's full generated texts.
fluency.aggregate: Equal request-occurrence macro over valid cases; also raw sum/count. Do not length-weight or deduplicate occurrences.
fluency.semantics: Repetition/diversity proxy, not grammatical fluency. Native empty ngram distribution yields valid entropy 0; missing generated observation is not invented0. Never label entropy*100 as a percentage.

consistency.formula: cosine(vec.transform([" ".join(full_generated_texts)]), vec.transform([" ".join(all snips[relation_id][target_new.id].text)])) using fixed vocabulary/idf and .toarray().
consistency.reference_selection: All relation_id/target_new.id snippets; not subject-name filtered essence subset. No essence perplexity evaluation requested.
consistency.invalid: No reference, no generation_prompts, empty/nonfinite vector or zero vector norm => typed missing reason; no NaN/Inf uploaded and no 0 fill. A genuinely measured orthogonal cosine0 is valid0.
consistency.aggregate: Equal request-occurrence macro of valid scores; raw sum/count plus planned denominator and reason counts. No successful-edit-only subset.
consistency.semantics: Lexical reference similarity, not factual consistency certification.

coverage.planned_count: All request occurrences in declared cohort, independent of metric validity.
coverage.generation_prompt_count: Actual prompt observations with declared per-case aggregation.
coverage.no_silent_filter: Keep every ordered case in local per-case records and denominator. Reasons may be descriptive nonexclusive; validity rules and counted unit explicit.

metrics.combined: Keep existing 3-way R/P/N success_harmonic_pct unchanged. Do not add fluency/consistency to that harmonic.

evaluation.current: 새 generation current/pre 및 current/post 평가는 하지 않는다. 기존 R/P/N current100 pre/post 일정과 편집 전후 state 의미는 그대로 유지한다.
evaluation.cumulative: 실제 W20/edits2000의 전체 ordered first2000에 대해서만 fluency/consistency를 측정한다. generation W5/W10/W15/current100/first500 subset 발행0. R/P/N의 원 milestone·cohort retention은 변경하지 않는다.
evaluation.W0: 새 W0 generation 전체·부분 평가0, 생성용 W0 READY를 편집 시작/후속 dependency prerequisite로 요구하지 않는다. 기존 R/P/N W0 관측·재사용은 유지한다. 옛 W0 generation raw/source/provenance는 삭제·새run backfill 없이 보존한다.
evaluation.w0_subsets: 새 W0 generation subset 지표 발행0. 기존 역사 행과 허용 key는 보존하되 새run의 미측정을0으로 채우지 않는다.
evaluation.completion: W20 완료 후 generation planned occurrences2000, 실제 prompt 수와 valid fluency/consistency 분모·결측 이유를 기록한다. W20 전에는 generation score/evidence0이 정상이며 40 intermediate endpoints 등 옛 collector 조건을 요구하지 않는다.
evaluation.qualification: 캐시/위치/RNG/비변이의 소수 prompt 기술 qualification은 기존 사전고정 plan 범위에서 허용되나 W0/current 과학점수로 게시하지 않는다. 추가 fit 또는 성능 gate가 아니다.
evaluation.existing_endpoint_reuse: 동일 W20 actual state/cohort/profile/seed/semantic identity가 검증된 관측만 재사용. endpoint는 arm별 독립 edited W/H이며 W0/다른 arm 관측으로 대신하지 않는다. R/P/N 중복 forward0.

wandb.transport: Reuse validated PRICE/native mapping and upload route; centralized helper migration/capability deployment is not a prerequisite. Minimal backward-compatible allowlist extension for these scalar keys is allowed.
wandb.axis: 새 generation 과학지표는 all_seen/post, edits=2000에서만. R/P/N edits/pre_state_edits/post_state_edits와 fit 단조 candidate 축은 그대로 유지한다. W20_generation progress는 별도 작업축으로 기록하며 부분값을 완성 W20 점수로 올리지 않는다.
wandb.privacy: Scalar metrics and whitelisted public metadata only. No generated text/tokens/case IDs/reference snippets/prompts/raw stdout/secret/model tensors in W&B or Git; no watch/artifact/code autosave. Actual job ID including arrays/index0/name job<id>, immutable UUID/group preserved.
wandb.missing: Omit unavailable mean; upload valid/planned counts and reasons. No NaN/Inf and no fabricated0.
wandb.verification: SDK acceptance != remote readback. Bounded startup/finish verification only, record precise state; network failure is not permission to refit/restart science.
